Every AI helpdesk on the market sells the same dream: flip a switch and resolve 80% of your tickets. What none of them mention on the sales page is that their AI expects you to show up with complete, accurate documentation. Most software teams don’t have that. Half the product was never written down, and the other half quietly went out of date months ago. So you turn on the bot anyway, and you barely resolve a fraction of your queue.
